inputs.name: PublicRelayController.constructor.env
inputs.description: The Worker's bindings and variables: REMOTE_HOSTS (required) is the Durable Object namespace that forward() uses to reach the host object on every forwarded request, and the constructor checks none of them. HARNESS_ENVIRONMENT (optional) is read by the guard's transport check, which refuses any request that is not https on every matched route in production and staging, and HARNESS_RELAY_ALLOWED_ORIGINS (optional) is the comma- or space-separated origin list that the connect guard checks when a connect request has an Origin header.

inputs.name: PublicRelayController.handle.request
inputs.description: The public HTTP request: handle chooses the route from its method and URL pathname, serving GET /v1/health, GET /v1/hosts/{hostId}/connect, GET /v1/hosts/{hostId}/pairings/{pairingId} (info), and POST on that pairing path with /request, /poll or /exchange appended, and any other method or path is answered 404. A connect request keeps its headers and drops its query string when forwarded, and a body is read only for the pairing actions request, poll and exchange, where it must be an application/json object of at most 16 KiB or the answer is 400.

outputs.name: PublicRelayController.handle
outputs.description: The Response to the request: the relay's own JSON answer, which is 200 with { ok: true, protocol } for GET /v1/health, 404 with error not-found for any other method or path, 400 tls-required from the transport check, 426 upgrade-required, 403 origin-denied or 401 credential-invalid from the connect guard, and 400 pairing-invalid (exchange) or invalid-input (request, poll) for an unreadable pairing body; a forwarded connect or pairing call returns the host object's own Response unchanged. Rejections that the controller does not catch are listed under errors.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown by new URL(request.url) in handle when the request URL is not a valid absolute URL, before any route is matched; handle does not catch it, so its promise rejects.

errors.name: DurableObjectStub.fetch rejection
errors.description: Whatever the host object's stub.fetch() rejects with when forward() sends a connect or pairing request to it; forward() does not catch it, so connect, pairing and handle reject with the same value.

errors.name: request body stream error
errors.description: The error a pairing call's request body stream fails with; the reader.read() or reader.cancel() calls in readJsonBody (through boundedBytes) reject with it and are not caught, so pairing and handle reject with it.

outputs.name: PublicRelayController.constructor
outputs.description: The constructor returns no value of its own: new PublicRelayController(env) yields the instance, which keeps env and a ConnectGuardMiddleware built from it, and the constructor validates nothing.
